observation: The selected byte projections for every positive candidate entry fit consecutive source-sector extents starting at LBA 41; the only trailing gap is 150 sectors per disc. Each source has 3711 Form 1 logical 2048-byte projections and respectively 17 or 12 explicit 2336-byte projections. Their independently measured CNF and boot executable hashes match exactly. Disc 1 has 3181 distinct projection keys, Disc 2 has 2194, with 2181 shared; 1000 and 13 respectively are absent on the other source. A complete 24-byte source projection explicitly reads "It's CDMAKE Dummy !" followed by CRLF/CRLF/space, SHA256 aafefb97ceb8e4667c719b99c4250b286e03087315b61848d196300140a95a2c; 11 Disc 1 slots and 1061 Disc 2 slots contain it. In the 1460-entry source group, all 730 consecutive pairs on Disc 1 contain non-dummy data; Disc 2 has 205 non-dummy pairs and 525 exact-dummy pairs, with no mixed pairs.
interpretation: These are reproducible physical source-byte relationships, including an explicit original dummy marker. Pair/source-slot availability can reject known missing data before scenario launch, but a non-dummy pair alone does not establish a valid scene, event state, original map name or controllable gameplay. Equal projections do not imply unique game-content counts or equivalent behavior. Game loader size conventions and full field mapping require separate execution evidence.

preconditions: Independent candidate index with boot/EOF cross-checks
commands: Compare both fingerprints by the recorded projection unit/length/SHA256; review complete 24-byte dummy entries at the listed coordinates and consecutive pair availability in field-pairs.json.
validation.expected: No selected extent overlap, exact independent boot/CNF hashes, bounds-safe complete projected reads; measured shared/distinct counts remain explicit and zero/dummy/duplicate source slots remain separately represented.
validation.actual: Both complete original scans and comparison passed. Three tests using invented data separately verify clipping/projection scope, malformed/truncated sectors, bounds, duplicate-slot preservation and unit-sensitive comparison. Exact dummy bytes were directly inspected under Nix Python.
validation.tolerance: Exact source coordinates, projected byte lengths and SHA256; no game-state, timing or native-runtime assertion.

limitations: Equal unit/length/SHA256 means equal selected source-byte projections, not equal gameplay behavior or unique original content IDs.
Duplicate and zero-byte projections remain separate source slots; their loader/game meaning is unresolved.
The 2336-byte projection is not an audio/video decoder or media asset count.
Private prefixes aid direct inspection and must not enter public metadata or distributed assets.
No native extractor, decoder, loader or game implementation is provided.
Non-dummy source bytes do not guarantee a valid or reachable field, story state, controllable player, or correct scene setup.
Known dummy pairs must be rejected before scenario launch; never treat their contents as field data or a no-op.
EVID-REF-007 separately corroborates these indices as original field selectors; this physical finding itself does not establish named scenes or progression paths.
Pair bounds come from the original source group. No unmeasured index or unknown adapter is silently accepted.
